profile.roleTitle: Technical Project Manager who turns complex ideas into delivered products.
profile.heroBio:
I’m Fazal Mahmud Hassan — a Technical Project Manager with a background in Computer Science and an MBA in HR & Management. I work at the intersection of technology, product delivery, people, and business, leading cross-functional teams to turn requirements into reliable, impactful solutions.

With experience across software delivery, healthcare technology, client management, operations, and team leadership, I’m driven by one thing: making complex work simpler, more structured, and more likely to succeed.
profile.aboutLead: I turn complex technology into things that work.
aboutBodyParagraphs:
I’m Fazal Mahmud Hassan — a Technical Project Manager with a Computer Science foundation and an MBA in HR & Management, experienced in taking projects from idea to delivery, leading cross-functional teams, working with clients, and solving the technical challenges along the way.

From software products and healthcare technology to small- and medium-scale system & network design, I bring together technology, people, and execution to turn ambitious ideas into practical, reliable outcomes.

articles.title: Bridging the Gap: How CS + MBA Thinking Transforms Project Delivery
articles.summary: Why technical fluency and business psychology are a superpower for Technical Project Managers navigating tight deadlines and stakeholder expectations.
articles.content:
In modern software engineering organizations, the biggest bottleneck is rarely writing code — it is translating strategic intent into unambiguous architectural milestones.

Having an engineering background gives project managers the ability to dissect architectural roadblocks and appreciate developer friction points. Paired with management frameworks from an MBA, you transition from simply tracking tasks to actively orchestrating team velocity, mitigating organizational friction, and communicating commercial impact directly to executive stakeholders.

articles.title: Managing 20+ Concurrent SaaS Workflows Without Sacrificing Code Quality
articles.summary: A practical framework for balancing rapid client iterations, resource allocation, and continuous integration across multiple enterprise software accounts.
articles.content:
When scaling across 20+ active project deliverables, relying on memory or ad-hoc status meetings is a recipe for missed deadlines. 

Standardizing discovery templates, building modular component libraries, and establishing strict definition-of-done criteria across QA and development enables teams to operate with predictability even under aggressive delivery timelines.

articles.title: From Breadboard to Springer Publication: Lessons from Building Bluetooth Robotics
articles.summary: Reflections on designing Arduino-based Android-controlled robotic prototypes and presenting peer-reviewed engineering findings on an international stage.
articles.content: Developing our Android-controlled Arduino robotics prototype taught me the essential discipline of hardware-software boundary testing. When communication latency can cause motor stall or packet loss, designing resilient serial packet validation is as critical as writing clean UI code.

He is an accomplished Technical Project Manager with proven expertise in Agile Project Management, Scrum, Python, Cloud Computing, SaaS, SDLC, Stakeholder Management, Risk Management, and Cross-functional Team Leadership.
